threat: Climate/background confounding (aridity, humidity, seasonality) of SUHI
mechanism: Climate jointly structures development timing by region and SUHI via rural-reference moisture/vegetation; C0 alone is inadequate
mitigation_in_design: Nested C0/C1/C2 from existing UCDB reanalysis bioclimatics + Koppen; nighttime primary; alternate-control-set test; leave-region-out

threat: Rural-reference definition and contamination (SUE generalized reference; irrigation/agriculture/phenology)
mechanism: SUHI is a difference; the reference LST varies independent of the city; reference may include peri-urban or disturbed land
mitigation_in_design: Nighttime primary; secondary outcome with different physics; alternate-reference product (DEA) if a city table exists; city-size and aridity strata
residual_risk: High: cannot be eliminated with one product

threat: Urban-boundary / cluster-definition mismatch between UCDB (GHSL) and thermal product (Landscan clusters)
mechanism: Clusters may merge several UCDB cities or differ in extent; S/H and R then refer to different footprints
mitigation_in_design: Polygon-based mutual one-to-one crosswalk with area-ratio bounds; merged clusters excluded from primary, aggregated in sensitivity; fixed-boundary H matches fixed Landscan extent

threat: Crosswalk error / selection into the matched sample
mechanism: Matched cities may be larger, more regular, and better detected by MODIS
mitigation_in_design: Pre-registered accept/ambiguous/reject rules; report matched vs unmatched balance; no fuzzy-name primary

threat: Temporal overlap: response window 2003-2018 overlaps H epochs 2005-2015 and precedes S(2020)
mechanism: No clean temporal-legacy reading; reverse-causal pathways (heat -> development) cannot be excluded
mitigation_in_design: Claim restricted to predictive association/transfer; strict-precedence sensitivity with H up to 2000 and S/H rebased to 2015

threat: Overlap/redundancy between H and present state S (density, built volume)
mechanism: H gain may only reflect nonlinear S structure; conversely S3 (built volume) may be a mediator and overcontrol
mitigation_in_design: Pseudo-history-from-S test; redundant-feature test; S1/S2/S3 gradient; H endpoint ratio excluded as in Gate 1

threat: Spatial autocorrelation and shared regional processing
mechanism: Neighbouring cities share rural context, overpass geometry, and climate -> inflated pseudo-replication
mitigation_in_design: Leave-region-out and leave-continent-out; spatial block bootstrap; random-vs-geographic fold comparison

mechanism: Pooled metrics dominated by Asia; small-region folds noisy
mitigation_in_design: Per-region reporting; pooled and region-weighted metrics; region-balanced sensitivity

threat: MODIS retrieval/cloud-sampling artifacts (clear-sky bias, emissivity, view angle)
mechanism: Clear-sky-only sampling and emissivity assumptions bias SUHI, more in humid cloudy and arid bare-soil cities
mitigation_in_design: Nighttime primary; secondary outcome shows daytime sensitivity; cloud-prone climate strata

threat: Vegetation/greenness as mediator (and as part of the reference)
mechanism: Urban greenness lies on the pathway H -> morphology/greening -> SUHI; conditioning removes real history signal; rural greenness confounds the reference
mitigation_in_design: Greenness/LULC excluded from primary C; exploratory C2+greenness variant reported as attenuation, never as primary

mechanism: SUHI scales with city size; size correlated with history
mitigation_in_design: Size in S; city-size stratified sensitivity

mechanism: Different aggregation units change both R and S/H
mitigation_in_design: Cluster-level aggregation sensitivity; two boundary definitions for H

mechanism: Day SUHI depends on insolation; seasonal definitions differ with latitude
mitigation_in_design: Latitude in C0; night primary; absolute latitude interactions via random forest

mechanism: Urban/rural elevation difference and lapse-rate effects on LST
mitigation_in_design: Elevation in C0; product filters urban-rural elevation difference

mechanism: Sea breeze and land-water contrast not in UCDB variables used
mitigation_in_design: Flagged; distance-to-coast not available without new raster; sensitivity via Koppen/region strata only

threat: Recent-urbanization stratum cannot be assessed under dynamic boundary
mechanism: 1005-5 matched sample (N=4,739) contains no cities with YOB>1990
mitigation_in_design: Fixed-boundary H primary on the full sample; dynamic H only as sensitivity
